Title: Aditya's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Aditya - 10 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Sonali - 40 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
3. Manoj - 37 years, father
Look: moustache, checked shirt
4. Savitri - 74 years, grandmother
Look: white saree, glasses
5. Kavya - 13 years, daughter
Look: red frock, a clip in her hair

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
3. The bedroom - a big bed, a wooden cupboard

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Aditya stands in the living room. Sonali, Manoj and Savitri stand near him.]

Manoj: "Let's do something fun today."

[Aditya writes in his notebook.]

Sonali: "Exactly right."

[Aditya does his homework at the table.]

Aditya: "What happened?"

[Aditya talks to his father on the phone.]

Aditya: "And then?"

[Aditya's phone rings and he answers it.]

Aditya (excited): "This is amazing!"

[Aditya types on his laptop.]

Sonali (gently): "What next?"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Aditya stands in the courtyard. Sonali and Manoj stand near him.]

Aditya: "What a nice place."

[Aditya hides behind the tree.]

Aditya (happily): "That was fun!"

[Aditya scratches his head.]

Aditya: "Yes, all right."

[Aditya stamps his foot in anger.]

Manoj: "Sonali, are you okay?"

[Flower petals rain down on Aditya.]

Aditya: "Exactly right."

Scene 3: The bedroom - Day

[Aditya stands in the bedroom. Sonali, Manoj and Savitri stand near him.]

Savitri: "Sonali, look over here."

[Aditya goes to bed and falls asleep.]

Aditya: "This is amazing!"

[Aditya sits on the edge of the bed.]

Savitri: "How beautiful!"

Scene 4: The courtyard - Day

[Aditya stands in the courtyard. Sonali, Manoj and Savitri stand near him.]

Savitri: "So, here we are!"

[A dust storm sweeps across the village.]

Aditya: "What next?"

[Dry leaves fall from the trees.]

Aditya (happily): "Exactly right."

[Flower petals rain down on Aditya.]

Manoj: "What next?"

[Birds chirp in the trees.]

Savitri: "And then?"

[A flock of birds flies across the sky.]

Aditya (surprised): "That's easy."

[Smoke rises from the chimney.]

Savitri (laughing): "Hey, look at that!"

[Aditya lights a bonfire.]

Aditya: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
